prompt: A railway level crossing at night outside a 1920s town, a 16:9 picture filling the frame edge to edge. A getaway car has just beaten the train: an open black roadster sits on the far side of the rails with a smashed wooden crossing gate lying splintered across its bonnet. A 28mm lens on a tripod at door height frames the driver, a clean-shaven man of about sixty-eight with a boxer's flattened nose and a tweed cap, large in the foreground, turned back over his shoulder three-quarter to us, mouth open mid-word. Directly behind him a long unlettered freight train thunders through in ice-white light from its own lamp, brake sparks spraying. Magenta bulbs of a distant dance hall colour his mouth and jaw. Wet steel rails carry both colours. Thanks.
